domain:ui#1 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5nLA7wiVY5YWjT9Svr

## 席位核对 · ACCEPT · 2026-11-07T22:44Z · head `aad134cc0c5367ab43ce58826542ab22fd5cb5e9`

Seat `domain:ui#1` reviewed the diff of its own dispatch (claim 6713333412 on #31267, card thread `session_01FEkQ5npnoTzeRFxu1Mj26Q`, report 6713876182). Read against GitHub, not the report.

1. **Shape:** 8 files, +551 / -259, all in the private `@object-ui/app-shell` marketplace folder plus its changeset. `listMarketplacePackages` takes `MarketplaceListParams` and sends `businessFunctions`, `industries`, `solutionTypes` (each one comma-joined parameter) and `maturity`, leaving out a facet that selects nothing, and no `category`. `MarketplacePage.tsx` reads one page of 24 with `limit` / `offset`, sends the debounced search as `q`, restarts at the first page on a new search or selection, and reads the side loads (installs, org packages) only on the first read, Refresh, Retry and after an install; the browser-side search and facet filter over the first 100 rows are gone. Body says `Fixes #31267`; no other closing keyword.
2. **Premise:** PR #31234 (merged) serves the four facets and paging on `GET /api/v1/marketplace/packages`; on `main` the console read one `{ limit: 100 }` window at `MarketplacePage.tsx:415` and filtered it in the browser.
3. **Gates / check-runs:** 55 runs on this head, 44 success, 11 skipped, 0 red. Dev: 37/37 derived gates exit 0 (the delta between the two measured heads is the changeset file alone), marketplace suites 58 files / 515 tests, app-shell type-check 0, six ablations red then restored. `mergeable_state` clean.
4. **Accepted deviations / notes:** facet buttons list every spec value without counts (the door serves no counts, and the spec's optional `facets` member has no producer); search is now the server's `q`, which matches name and app ID but no longer the description or a localized name. Both are named in the PR body; neither has a pull behind it yet, so no follow-up card is filed. The default deployment forwards facets to cloud, which adopts the names on cloud#3661.
5. **Out of scope / Skills-docs:** `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` hold as claimed (only the private `@object-ui/app-shell`, no i18n key). No `packages/spec/src` path, so `Skills-docs:` is not owed. Nothing filed.
6. **Landing:** `check-governed-merges --pr 31288`: not governed, 810 changed lines, so no human approval owed. `Clause-②: no`, so no contract review is owed. Landing on the maintainer's standing words 「按照 pm-dispatch 规则复核过的都授权」 (2026-10-25T11:35Z) and 「你应该使用 pm-dispatch 技能审核和落地pr」 (2026-11-07T16:59Z). Relay `pr_ready` + `automerge_enable` once PR #31284 (the fix for the queue-flake anchor #31285 that has ejected three PRs) is on `main`, so this PR does not ride into the same ejection. On merge #31267 closes by `Fixes`; the seat removes `pm:dispatched`.
